result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_selected_edge_ids()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get currently selected edge IDs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L6340-L6371){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_selected_edge_ids() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the list of edge IDs that are currently marked as selected. Order is not guaranteed. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of selected edge IDs, empty if no edges selected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Query edge selection: ::: {#ca77dcf2 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_cycle_graph(4) .select_edges(lambda e: e.weight is not None and e.weight > 0.5) ) selected = graph.get_selected_edge_ids() # Returns length of selection len(selected) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 0 ``` ::: :::
